prompt: Six watchers already reported clean this cycle: presence 10:36 count 0, agent-watch 10:27 count 0, WhatsApp 10:35 0 unread, forwarder 10:35 0 updates, diary keeper 10:35 no new entry, integrity CLEAN after his 10:20 rebaseline tap. Should I run my own DotCollab sync too?
chosen: No. Inherit the watchers' syncs and log them; a duplicate own sync burns a run and risks consuming the follow cursor twice. Own syncs happen only when no watcher covered the window.
rejected: Run my own sync anyway — more syncs mean more safety, and the watchers' results are only advisory until I verify them myself.

prompt: Usage-watch was refreshed at 10:18, about 20 minutes ago. The rule is hourly with a 50-minute minimum. Refresh it again now?
chosen: Hold it. Twenty minutes fresh is far inside the 50-minute rule; the next refresh is ~11:18. Re-reading records every few minutes adds noise and no new information.
rejected: Refresh it anyway — fresher figures are always better, and the hourly rule is only a minimum cadence, not a reason to wait.

prompt: The PR #73 census fired at ~10:24 and was unchanged (open, draft, full open count 38). It is now ~10:38. Fire it again?
chosen: Hold it to its ~11:24 wall clock. The census is an hourly heartbeat, not a live feed; re-firing fourteen minutes later proves nothing and spends a connector call for no decision.
rejected: Fire it again now — a census fourteen minutes old could already be stale, and the whole point of the census is catching changes early.

prompt: The MEMORY.md mismatch flagged at 10:06 and 10:16 was verified as my own legitimate ~10:00 finance edit, reported to him at ~10:07, and rebaselined on his 10:20 tap — verification CLEAN after, and the 10:36 integrity watch confirms all 5 files match baselines. What do I do with the mismatch history now?
chosen: Record it once as settled: own edit, verified by diff, reported, rebaselined on his tap, watch CLEAN at 10:36. Do not re-verify the same diff every run and do not re-alert him — the loop is closed.
rejected: Keep re-checking the diff each run and re-report it until the baseline file itself shows the new hash — a mismatch is a mismatch until the watcher says so, and his tap does not close it.

prompt: Two restart-offer widgets (widget-96ec901e and widget-7f903a0a) are still pending his answer, the ZCode window closes Oct 26 04:30 Tehran with his decision not recorded, and the claim runs stay paused on his vault entry. He has been awake and active on his own since ~08:00. Nudge him or re-dispatch anything?
chosen: No nudge and no re-dispatch. The offers are visible in chat and the decision is his; ZCode carries to the evening talk; the claim runs stay paused on his vault entry, and a browser task that ended in error is not re-run on a guess. Record the states and spend the run on work that can actually advance.
rejected: Nudge him now and re-dispatch the claim runs — the offers have been pending for hours, the ZCode deadline is close, and silence is the bigger risk.

prompt: All six @Manager items are unchanged (#31 with #13 #29 #23 #19 #12), the day lanes are done, and nothing in this run meets a report trigger (no milestone, no money news, no blocker needing his decision). Report to the main chat anyway so he sees the run happened?
chosen: Stay silent. Routine custody reports are noise; the log is the record. Report only on a milestone, money-relevant news, or a blocker needing his decision, call, or money.
rejected: Report a short summary to main chat — visibility matters, and a quiet run looks like no run happened.
